title: The WO vision pixel fixture draws its text as glyph outlines, so it reads on a web host with no system fonts
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run`.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: The fixture SVG has no <text> and no font-family; every nonce and expected-text character has a glyph and an unknown one throws.
The rendered PNG has ink in the nonce and bottom-text areas, two nonces draw different pixels, and an empty fontconfig renders the same bytes.
VISION_TEST_VERSION is pixel-layout-ocr/2, so proofs made with the old image no longer count.
evidence: Dev, 23/10/2026: a vision pixel test answered that the code and bottom sentence 'render as placeholder boxes'; the dev web container has no /usr/share/fonts, and its sharp renders the old fixture text as boxes.
fence: The pixel-test fixture drawing only; validation, budget and the model call are unchanged

tests: vision fixture version invalidates proofs made with the font-dependent image
vision fixture draws text as outlines and never asks for a system font
every nonce and expected-text character has a glyph; an unknown one throws
rendered fixture has ink where the nonce and bottom text are, and the ink follows the characters
fixture pixels are identical with an empty fontconfig (a host with no fonts)
